name: Goblin Invasion
summary:
Goblin Invasion is a fantasy-based game about being a sorcerer. With the innovative mechanics of drawing and casting spells, the player defends their village against the forces of evil. 
Be the most powerful magician and protect your loved ones from evil goblins. From your tower, you must prevent the waves of enemies from taking down the gate and breaking into the village.
